question: Actions of cholecystokinin include which one of the following?

options.opb: Secretion of pancreatic juice rich in enzymes

analysis: Cholecystokinin is a hormone released in response to the presence of fats and proteins in the duodenum. Its actions include stimulating the contraction of the gall bladder to release bile into the duodenum, as well as stimulating the secretion of pancreatic juice rich in enzymes to aid in digestion.
